notes:
This release brings guided setup, zero-install agent CLIs, and a much better diff viewer.

### New

- **Guided setup assistant** — a new scaffolding agent walks you through getting your workspace ready, with a streamlined agent-selection step in Quickstart.
- **Automatic agent installation** — turning on an agent now installs everything it needs for you, so there's nothing to set up by hand.
- **GitHub-style diffs** — file changes render as a clean unified diff that's much easier to scan.
- **Review folder updates before they land** — see what's changing in a folder update and approve it before it's applied.
- **Palette documentation, built in** — agents can now look up Palette's own documentation while they work.
- **Shared HTML files in Organisational context** — HTML files shared with you now show up alongside your other context.
- **Automatic runtime updates** — Palette checks for updates to its agent runtimes on launch and when you come back to the app.
- **A nicer installer** — the drag-to-Applications window now has a proper background.

### Improved

- **Cleaner composer toolbar** — the controls beneath the message box now line up at a consistent height.
- **Sharper markdown** — text and rich content in the viewer render more consistently across the app.
- **Trusted agent versions** — Palette only uses agent tools it knows are recent enough to work correctly.

### Fixed

- **Allow All and Plan on Gemini and Mistral** — both controls now work on Gemini and Mistral tabs.
- **No more crossed-up conversations** — each message is routed to the tab it came from, so replies can't land in the wrong session.
- **Session picker no longer hangs** — if one provider fails to list its sessions, the picker still loads.
- **Handoffs land reliably** — a handed-off session now receives its starting message every time.
- **Publishing to read-only folders** — Palette now tells you upfront instead of failing partway through.
- **Correct Codex models** — the model list is checked against the Codex version Palette is actually running.
- **Tool permission prompts** — permission requests now match the right tool call.
- **Working Slack invite** — the community link in Help points to a fresh invite.
